lines.text: Twelve people. One project. Every task in one place.
This is TeamBoard: the kanban board built for our SEP team.
lines.say: This is Team Board: the kanban board built for our S.E.P. team.

lines.text: Think Trello, but ours.
You can keep several boards, but one is all you need to start.
Columns hold cards, with coloured labels, due dates and the avatars of whoever is on it.
Finished something? Just drag the card to the next column.
And everyone sees it instantly.
When Miki moves a card, it moves on your screen too. No refresh.
lines.say: When Mickey moves a card, it moves on your screen too. No refresh.

lines.text: The green Live dot means you're in sync.
Open a card for the full picture: description, due date and assignees.
Reviewers get the eye icon, labels keep things sorted, and comments hold the discussion.
Busy board? Filter by assignee or reviewer, or just search.
Right-click any card or column for quick actions.
And yes, there's a dark mode.
TeamBoard also works with Claude.
lines.say: Team Board also works with Claude.

lines.text: Open Connect to Claude from your avatar menu and add the connector to claude.ai or Claude Code.
lines.say: Open Connect to Claude from your avatar menu, and add the connector to Claude dot A I, or Claude Code.

lines.text: Claude can read your boards, create cards and move them, as you, with your permissions.
Ask for a card, and it shows up live.
Coming from Trello? Import a board from its JSON export: lists, cards, labels and comments come along.
lines.say: Coming from Trello? Import a board from its Jason export. Lists, cards, labels and comments come along.

lines.text: Admins run the Team page: add people directly, or send an invite link.
To get started, go to teamboard-sep.vercel.app.
lines.say: To get started, go to team board dash S E P dot vercel dot app.

lines.text: Log in with your first name @teamboard.local, then change your password from the avatar menu.
lines.say: Log in with your first name, at team board dot local. Then change your password from the avatar menu.

lines.text: See you on the board!
